extends.note: records of the base table are never repeated here; a consumer merges this table under the base one (the base wins on a record both name)

conventions.frame: wheel slot frame: metres, spin axis X, -X outboard on all four car wheels (E0.5); offset and scale are the prop localTransform position and visualScale [x, y, z]
conventions.scale: lip radius = min(stock rim outer radius, tyre bead radius + 0.0015) / rimBase.radius on Y and Z; X is the same on cars (uniform), the stock rim width / rimBase.width on motorcycles
conventions.offset: x = stock rim face x (after its visualScale) - scale.x * rimBase.face_x, so the new lip face is flush with the stock one; y = z = 0
conventions.hide: record fit: the stock rim components of the player appearance on the contract slots (never a tyre), plus rim centres on brake slots that reach into the new rim; on a record whose spawned appearance is not fixed (playerAppearanceSource "first entity appearance"), plus the stock rim names of every other appearance (a name the current appearance lacks is skipped by the client); an appearance entry carries its own list only
conventions.slots: per-slot offset/scale where a wheel differs from the front-left (car) or front (bike) one; a client that ignores it puts the record-level fit on every wheel
conventions.extraSlots: wheels beyond the contract slots (Merrimac middle axle): slot -> offset, scale, hide; not covered by setWheels as specified
conventions.slotNames: motorcycles: contract slot -> the stock slot the stock rim binds to (the offset is measured in that frame)
conventions.rightSide: no extra turn: right slot frames are the left ones turned 180 deg about Z (so -X stays outboard), and the stock right rims use the left mesh unrotated or with a spin phase about X only (mountTable[].rightSide per model)
conventions.appearances: only on a record whose spawned appearance is not fixed: entity appearance -> { offset, scale, slots?, extraSlots?, slotNames?, hide }, where one of its main wheels moves more than 1 cm or scales more than 3 % against the record fit (E1c rule); at most 32 per record; each entry replaces only the fields it gives (contract "Per-appearance fits")
conventions.appearanceFits: record -> appearance -> the same entry shape, for every appearance out of tolerance or with other stock rim names: measured data for curated trims, not registered
conventions.appearanceSummary: every entity appearance of the record: its wheel variant (measure plan key), its largest wheel delta against the record fit, within or out of tolerance, otherRimNames when its stock rims carry other names, or none (no rims or tyres on a contract slot: burnt or damaged, or a tyre bound to the rim rather than to a slot)

scope: every Vehicle.*_player* record of the inventory (cars and motorcycles) the base table does not name, except quest variants (Vehicle.q<digits>_*: out of the extension, owner's decision of 2026-11-07)
